<script>
(function () {
  if (typeof jQuery === 'undefined') { return; }
  var $ = jQuery, panel = document.getElementById('fh-mcart'), timer;
  if (!panel) { return; }

  function open(auto) {
    panel.classList.add('is-open');
    panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    clearTimeout(timer);
    if (auto) { timer = setTimeout(close, 6000); } // non-intrusive: auto-dismiss
  }
  function close() {
    panel.classList.remove('is-open');
    panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
  panel.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { clearTimeout(timer); });
  panel.addEventListener('focusin', function () { clearTimeout(timer); });

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest('.fh-mcart__close')) { close(); return; }
    var cartBtn = e.target.closest('.fh-cartbtn');
    if (cartBtn) {
      e.preventDefault(); // header cart icon toggles the mini-cart
      panel.classList.contains('is-open') ? close() : open(false);
      return;
    }
    if (panel.classList.contains('is-open') && !e.target.closest('#fh-mcart')) { close(); }
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') { close(); } });

  /* WooCommerce's add-to-cart.js appends an <a class="added_to_cart">View cart</a>
     after the button on success. Remove it on the same event it is inserted,
     give the button transient "Added" feedback, and open the mini-cart. */
  function stripViewCart() { $('.fh-card .added_to_cart, .fh-pp__card .added_to_cart, .fh-na__spotbtns .added_to_cart').remove(); }
  $(document.body).on('added_to_cart', function (ev, fragments, hash, $button) {
    stripViewCart();
    setTimeout(stripViewCart, 0); // handler order varies with script load order
    if ($button && $button.length) {
      var b = $button[0];
      if (!b.dataset.fhOrig) { b.dataset.fhOrig = b.innerHTML; }
      b.classList.add('is-added');
      b.innerHTML = '✓ Added';
      setTimeout(function () {
        b.classList.remove('is-added');
        b.innerHTML = b.dataset.fhOrig;
      }, 1600);
    }
    open(true);
  });
  $(document.body).on('removed_from_cart', function () {
    $('.fh-card .added_to_cart, .fh-pp__card .added_to_cart, .fh-na__spotbtns .added_to_cart').remove();
  });
})();
</script>

(function () {
  function tune(img) {
    if (!img.naturalWidth || !img.naturalHeight) { return; }
    var r = img.naturalWidth / img.naturalHeight;
    if (r > 1.75 || r < 0.6) { img.classList.add('is-contain'); }
  }
  function scan(root) {
    (root.querySelectorAll ? root.querySelectorAll('.fh-card__media img') : []).forEach(function (img) {
      if (img.complete) { tune(img); }
      else { img.addEventListener('load', function () { tune(img); }, { once: true }); }
    });
  }
  scan(document);
})();

<script>
(function () {
  var KEY = 'fh_wl';
  function list() { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)) || []; } catch (e) { return []; } }
  function save(a) { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(a)); paint(); }
  function paint() {
    var a = list();
    document.querySelectorAll('.fh-wlcount').forEach(function (b) {
      b.textContent = a.length;
      b.classList.toggle('is-hidden', a.length === 0);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.fh-card__wish[data-id]').forEach(function (btn) {
      var on = a.indexOf(parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-id'), 10)) !== -1;
      btn.classList.toggle('is-on', on);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', on ? 'Remove from wishlist' : 'Add to wishlist');
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest('.fh-card__wish[data-id]');
    if (!btn) { return; }
    var id = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-id'), 10);
    var a = list(), i = a.indexOf(id);
    if (i === -1) { a.push(id); } else { a.splice(i, 1); }
    btn.classList.add('is-pop');
    setTimeout(function () { btn.classList.remove('is-pop'); }, 320);
    save(a);
    /* on the wishlist page, un-hearting removes the card */
    var grid = document.getElementById('fh-wl-grid');
    if (grid && i !== -1) {
      var card = btn.closest('.fh-card');
      if (card) { card.remove(); }
      wlState();
    }
  });

  function wlState() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('fh-wl-grid');
    if (!grid) { return; }
    var n = grid.querySelectorAll('.fh-card').length;
    var count = document.getElementById('fh-wl-count');
    count.textContent = n ? (n + (n === 1 ? ' saved product' : ' saved products')) : '';
    grid.hidden = n === 0;
    document.getElementById('fh-wl-empty').hidden = n !== 0;
  }

  function initPage() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('fh-wl-grid');
    if (!grid) { return; }
    var a = list();
    if (!a.length) { wlState(); return; }
    fetch('https://fahavicomputers.co.ke/wp-json/fahavi/v1/wishlist-cards?include=' + a.join(','))
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        if (d && d.ok) {
          grid.innerHTML = d.html;
          /* prune products that no longer exist */
          if (d.valid_ids.length !== a.length) { save(d.valid_ids); }
        }
        wlState(); paint();
      })
      .catch(function () { wlState(); });
  }

  paint();
  initPage();
})();
</script>

(function () {
  var burger = document.querySelector('.fh-burger'),
      drawer = document.getElementById('fh-drawer'),
      back   = document.getElementById('fh-backdrop');
  if (!burger || !drawer || !back) { return; }
  var closeBtn = drawer.querySelector('.fh-drawer__close');
  var isOpen = false;

  function open() {
    if (isOpen) { return; }
    isOpen = true;
    back.hidden = false;
    void back.offsetWidth; // sync reflow so the transition runs; no rAF (frozen in hidden tabs)
    drawer.classList.add('is-open');
    back.classList.add('is-open');
    drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    document.documentElement.classList.add('fh-lock');
    closeBtn.focus();
  }
  function close() {
    if (!isOpen) { return; }
    isOpen = false;
    drawer.classList.remove('is-open');
    back.classList.remove('is-open');
    drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('fh-lock');
    setTimeout(function () { if (!isOpen) { back.hidden = true; } }, 380);
    burger.focus();
  }

  burger.addEventListener('click', open);
  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', close);
  back.addEventListener('click', close);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { close(); }
  });
  // navigating from the menu should close it (same-page anchors especially)
  drawer.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest('a')) { close(); }
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  var SEND_TO = 'AW-18231849009/oObRCP_14-wcELHgz_VD';
  var KEY = 'fahavi_gclid';
  var TTL = 90 * 24 * 3600 * 1000;

  // Remember the ad click ID from the landing URL.
  function store(v) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(v)); } catch (e) {}
  }
  function load() {
    try {
      var v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null');
      return v && (Date.now() - v.t) < TTL ? v : null;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  var qs = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  var id = qs.get('gclid') || qs.get('gbraid') || qs.get('wbraid');
  if (id) { store({ id: id, t: Date.now(), landing: location.pathname }); }

  function ref(click) {
    return 'G-' + click.id.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '').slice(-6).toUpperCase();
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var a = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[href]') : null;
    if (!a) { return; }
    var h = a.getAttribute('href') || '';
    var isWa = h.indexOf('wa.me/') !== -1 || h.indexOf('api.whatsapp.com') !== -1;
    var isLead = isWa || h.indexOf('tel:') === 0;
    if (!isLead) { return; }

    if (typeof gtag === 'function') {
      gtag('event', 'conversion', { 'send_to': SEND_TO });
      gtag('event', h.indexOf('tel:') === 0 ? 'call_click' : 'whatsapp_click', { 'link_url': h });
    }

    var click = isWa ? load() : null;
    if (!click) { return; }
    var code = ref(click);
    try {
      var u = new URL(a.href);
      var text = u.searchParams.get('text') || '';
      if (text.indexOf('Ref: G-') === -1) {
        u.searchParams.set('text', (text ? text + '\n\n' : '') + 'Ref: ' + code);
        a.href = u.toString();
      }
    } catch (err) {}

    var body = JSON.stringify({ gclid: click.id, ref: code, page: location.href.split('?')[0],
                                landing: click.landing || '', product: document.title });
    if (navigator.sendBeacon) {
      navigator.sendBeacon("https:\/\/fahavicomputers.co.ke\/wp-json\/fahavi\/v1\/wa-lead", new Blob([body], { type: 'application/json' }));
    }
  }, true);
})();
</script>
